decision.reasoning_trace: I focused on actual Bluetooth speakers, filtering out the many chargers, carrying cases, and accessories in the feed. My consideration set included a mix of entry-level (EWA), professional (Jabra), mid-range (DOSS, JBL Renewed), and premium (JBL Pulse) options. I ultimately selected the DOSS SoundBox Pro+ because it offers a high rating of 4.6 with a substantial review count, providing confidence in its performance. It hits a sweet spot for features—24W sound, IPX6 waterproofing, and LED lights—at a reasonable price of $89.99, making it a better value than the overpriced Libratone or the refurbished JBL Flip 5 which had some reported battery issues.
